name: moon
description: A balanced crescent moon with a clean circular concavity.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: The crescent preserves the recognizable lunar silhouette as an intentional circular exception to the rounded rectangular object baseline. A radius-8 outer arc and a radius-9 concave inner arc share the original horn endpoints. At the owner request, the inner arc midpoint moves approximately 1.17 units toward the artboard center to reduce the indentation; the outer contour and both horn endpoints are retained. One closed path avoids doubled edges. Native centerline bounds remain x/y=4.35424869..19.64575131; Regular 1.70 gives equal opposite visible margins of 3.50424869. Rounded stroke joins soften both horns. Static draft awaiting owner review.
